name: dsh-ollama
description: Ollama as a measured surface: five `ollama_*` tools over the machine's own daemon (status, one bounded run with its token counts and durations, a benchmark that reports 3+ runs as a median with spread, models with confirmed pull/delete, embeddings with cosine similarity), the loopback fence that refuses a daemon on another machine by default, and three skills that teach the REST API, the metric arithmetic and the Python client. Host-only: one row, no route, no browser half, zero npm dependencies, no bundled engine, nothing started on its own.
